name: inspect-2018-figure
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import subprocess,base64
p=subprocess.run(['pdftoppm','-f','3','-l','3','-singlefile','-scale-to','1600','-png','sources/hujdurovic-2018.pdf'],capture_output=True,timeout=20);assert p.returncode==0,p.stderr
s=base64.b64encode(p.stdout).decode()
w=subprocess.run(['python3','-I','-B','write_lane.py','sources/hujdurovic-2018-page3.png','--base64'],input=s,text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=10);assert w.returncode==0,w.stderr
print(s)
